text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"And now for our special feature! It's 
time for today's Twinkle Legend segment!"

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Introducing the legendary Triple Crown 
Umamusume and the Umamusume who claimed 
the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I guess there really isn't anyone like 
that. Someone who'd turn their back on 
glory and jump ship halfway through.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, has there ever been an Umamusume 
who went from the "Oka Sho" to the Derby 
and won?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Unprecedented, huh...? Damn, my blood is 
pumping...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I guess that just shows how 
difficult it is. Different paths mean 
completely different rivals, after all."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Going straight into the real deal against 
the Satsuki Sho crowd when you've never 
run against them once is sheer madness."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't regret running the Oka Sho, but... 
Talk about an expensive detour.

"If she really goes from the Oka Sho to 
the Derby, she might get cold looks from 
the girls aiming straight for the Triple 
Crown or the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can't see the exit... And there's not a 
single clue.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, where should I even begin 
thinking from?
choice_data_list:
All I can think of is... maybe asking an 
upperclassman?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Senpai... Someone who once ran in the 
Derby, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then let's head to that 
person! If it's them, an even bigger rogue 
than me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What, going from the Oka Sho to the Tokyo 
Yushun (Japanese Derby)?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I wanted to hear the opinion of 
Brian-senpai, who has forged countless 
heroic legends herself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Are you really aiming for that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's why I came to you, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Please. Please... tell me what happened.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —I have nothing to say.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, Senpai! Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Persistent.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me all about the Derby! 
Everything you felt at that dream stage, 
Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It has to be you, Brian-senpai! I feel 
like only your eyes would understand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—The Japanese Derby. It's a special place. 
Not somewhere meant for people just 
chasing daydreams.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's a place where "those who come to 
devour their idols" gather.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Those who have come... to devour their 
idols...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"If your soul yearns for it, you have no 
choice but to go. On the other hand, if it 
doesn't, you're better off not going."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You are likely—cut from the same cloth as 
me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Kindred spirits? Me and Senpai?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"What's the point of planning out the 
future? Do you really think going 
according to schedule will bring you 
fulfillment?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose, it only leaves me thirsty for 
more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Follow your instincts. Don't pretend to 
be an ordinary Umamusume now."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That is why I have no advice for you. That 
is all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Brian-senpai...

That night, I heard about what happened 
with Narita Brian. And then—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it's something I have to 
decide for myself. Just me and Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you think? If you were 
Trainer, where would you start thinking 
from?

The standard Vodka should judge herself 
by. That is...
choice_data_list:
I wonder what it really means to be 
cool...
What does it mean to be cool, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Cool...? Is that what I'm always aiming 
for...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Never wavering, never backing down, never 
looking back... I always thought that's 
what being cool is all about, though.
choice_data_list: What would be the coolest way to do it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What do you mean... right here?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're right... My own style is 
whatever feels cool to me, huh...

Vodka pondered for a long time, as if 
glaring deep into herself.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What I consider "cool" is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The dream I've had since I was a kid. To 
challenge it...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even if everyone thinks it's reckless, 
smashing through common sense like that...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“It's not about the competition. It starts 
with me. With myself—”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone thinks, I will stick 
to my own principles.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Admiration isn't something you chase. It's 
something you devour. You sink your teeth 
in and take it down.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's what makes me cool. In that case—
The long night finally broke into dawn.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, will you watch over me... as I 
charge right in?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"People might laugh at me. I might 
collapse. Even so—!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I want to live my life cool and true to 
myself! That's why—I want to go to the 
Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! Exactly! Now this is 
the real me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run wherever my heart takes me! 
From the Oka Sho straight to the Japanese 
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what anyone says! I'm just 
gonna stay true to who I am!
